inconsistencies.issue: Segment conditions field type mismatch - SDK uses map[string]interface{} but OpenAPI defines a structured MongoDB query object
inconsistencies.expected: Conditions should be properly typed as a MongoDB query structure with operators like $eq, $and, $or
inconsistencies.actual: Using generic map[string]interface{} which loses type safety
inconsistencies.impact: Users may pass incorrectly structured conditions that fail at runtime
inconsistencies.recommendation: Define a proper Condition type with MongoDB operators

inconsistencies.issue: CreateContactParams is missing the 'city' field defined in OpenAPI spec
inconsistencies.expected: City field should be present as an optional string field
inconsistencies.actual: City field is missing from CreateContactParams struct
inconsistencies.impact: Users cannot set the city field when creating contacts via SDK

inconsistencies.issue: UpdateContactParams is missing the 'city' field defined in OpenAPI spec
inconsistencies.expected: City field should be present as an optional string field
inconsistencies.actual: City field is missing from UpdateContactParams struct
inconsistencies.impact: Users cannot update the city field for contacts via SDK

inconsistencies.impact: Minor inconsistency with Go naming conventions
inconsistencies.recommendation: Consider renaming to APIKeysSvc following Go idioms for acronyms
inconsistencies.codeExample:
type APIKeysSvc interface {...}

typeDiscrepancies.recommendation: Add City *string `json:"city,omitempty"` to CreateContactParams and UpdateContactParams

fieldMappingIssues.issue: Generic map type instead of structured MongoDB query type

recommendations.title: Add missing 'city' field to Contact structs
recommendations.description: The CreateContactParams and UpdateContactParams structs are missing the 'city' field that is defined in the OpenAPI specification
recommendations.rationale: This prevents SDK users from setting or updating the city field for contacts, limiting functionality
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: Add `City *string `json:"city,omitempty"`` to both CreateContactParams and UpdateContactParams structs

recommendations.title: Define proper MongoDB query condition types for Segments
recommendations.description: The Conditions field in segment-related structs uses generic map[string]interface{} which loses compile-time type safety
recommendations.rationale: Proper typing would help SDK users construct valid MongoDB queries and catch errors at compile time
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: Create condition builder types with proper operators like $eq, $and, $or, $gt, $lt, etc.

recommendations.title: Consider renaming ApiKeys to APIKeys following Go conventions
recommendations.description: Go conventions suggest using API (all caps) for acronyms in type names
recommendations.rationale: This would align with standard Go naming conventions (e.g., HTTPServer, URLParser)
recommendations.suggestedImplementation: Rename ApiKeysSvc to APIKeysSvc and ApiKeysSvcImpl to APIKeysSvcImpl
